text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: Just because you've got a weapon drawn doesn't mean that I'm gonna give# you what you want . . .
source_text:
Just because you've got a weapon drawn doesn't mean that I'm gonna give
# you what you want . . .

text: 别以为你手里有家伙我就会怕你……
source_text: 别以为你手里有家伙我就会怕你……

text: You've beaten me! What more do you want, dammit!
source_text: You've beaten me! What more do you want, dammit!

text: 你打了我！你还要干什么，我靠！
source_text: 你打了我！你还要干什么，我靠！

text: I don't got nothing to say! Talk is for the weak!
source_text: I don't got nothing to say! Talk is for the weak!

text: 我什么都不说！说话是弱者的能事！
source_text: 我什么都不说！说话是弱者的能事！

text: I don't know who you are, but I'll give you a fair warning: anyone who# messes with the Khans, dies messy.
source_text:
I don't know who you are, but I'll give you a fair warning: anyone who
# messes with the Khans, dies messy.

text: 我不知道你是谁，但是我明白地警告你：谁敢和可汗帮过不去，死路一条。
source_text: 我不知道你是谁，但是我明白地警告你：谁敢和可汗帮过不去，死路一条。

text: You know, if you really thought you were stronger, you'd kill me.
source_text: You know, if you really thought you were stronger, you'd kill me.

text: 你要是真觉得你强，你就把我杀了！
source_text: 你要是真觉得你强，你就把我杀了！

text: Too bad. I'm messing with you!
source_text: Too bad. I'm messing with you!

text: 抱歉，我就要和你过不去！
source_text: 抱歉，我就要和你过不去！

text: Fine. Let's not mess with each other, and we'll be happy.
source_text: Fine. Let's not mess with each other, and we'll be happy.

text: 好吧，我们井水不犯河水，大家高兴。
source_text: 好吧，我们井水不犯河水，大家高兴。

text: I surrender. Please don't kill me!
source_text: I surrender. Please don't kill me!

text: 我投降，别杀我！
source_text: 我投降，别杀我！

text: Hngrrr!
source_text: Hngrrr!

text: Huh?
source_text: Huh?

text: 哈？
source_text: 哈？

text: Hail brother Khan! How goes the hunt? Have many weaklings died today?
source_text: Hail brother Khan! How goes the hunt? Have many weaklings died today?

text: 嗨，可汗帮的老兄！买卖不错吧，杀了多少贱民？
source_text: 嗨，可汗帮的老兄！买卖不错吧，杀了多少贱民？

text: Hail sister Khan! How goes the hunt? Have many weaklings died today?
source_text: Hail sister Khan! How goes the hunt? Have many weaklings died today?

text: 嗨，可汗帮的老姐！买卖不错吧，杀了多少贱民？
source_text: 嗨，可汗帮的老姐！买卖不错吧，杀了多少贱民？

text: I will save my boasts for the campfire, but I have many tales to tell!
source_text: I will save my boasts for the campfire, but I have many tales to tell!

text: 我现在不想吹牛，我有很多事迹要说！
source_text: 我现在不想吹牛，我有很多事迹要说！

text: I have seen much blood and taken much plunder.
source_text: I have seen much blood and taken much plunder.

text: 他们流了很多血，我的收获不错。
source_text: 他们流了很多血，我的收获不错。

text: Not bad. How about you?
source_text: Not bad. How about you?

text: 不错，你呢？
source_text: 不错，你呢？

text: I've done better . . .
source_text: I've done better . . .

text: 我干得更棒……
source_text: 我干得更棒……

text: You are an enemy of the Khans! You attack our warriors and take our women!# Give me a reason why I shouldn't cut out your heart!
source_text:
You are an enemy of the Khans! You attack our warriors and take our women!
# Give me a reason why I shouldn't cut out your heart!

text: 你是可汗帮的敌人！你杀了我们的男人，抢了我们的女人！你倒是说一个不杀你的理由！
source_text: 你是可汗帮的敌人！你杀了我们的男人，抢了我们的女人！你倒是说一个不杀你的理由！

text: Cut the bravado. Where's Tandi? Tell me, or you die!
source_text: Cut the bravado. Where's Tandi? Tell me, or you die!

text: 少废话！坦蒂在哪里？说，要不你就是死人！
source_text: 少废话！坦蒂在哪里？说，要不你就是死人！

text: Can't think of anything. Let's fight!
source_text: Can't think of anything. Let's fight!

text: 想不出，开打吧！
source_text: 想不出，开打吧！

text: Because we'll both live if you don't try.
source_text: Because we'll both live if you don't try.

text: 你要是不动手，我们还都是活人。
source_text: 你要是不动手，我们还都是活人。

text: I'm in no condition to fight. I surrender.
source_text: I'm in no condition to fight. I surrender.

text: 我现在不在状态，我投降。
source_text: 我现在不在状态，我投降。

text: Are you one of them? One of the mutants?
source_text: Are you one of them? One of the mutants?

text: 你是他们的成员之一？变种人？
source_text: 你是他们的成员之一？变种人？

text: What do you know about mutants?
source_text: What do you know about mutants?

text: 你知道什么关于变种人的事情？
source_text: 你知道什么关于变种人的事情？

text: Yeah, I'm a mutant!
source_text: Yeah, I'm a mutant!

text: 没错，我就是变种人！
source_text: 没错，我就是变种人！

text: Do I look like a mutant to you?
source_text: Do I look like a mutant to you?

text: 我看起来像是变种人吗？
source_text: 我看起来像是变种人吗？

text: No.
source_text: No.

text: 不。
source_text: 不。

text: Perhaps. If you wish to fight, I'll fight. If you wish to go in peace,# you have my word as a Khan that I will not attack.
source_text:
Perhaps. If you wish to fight, I'll fight. If you wish to go in peace,
# you have my word as a Khan that I will not attack.

text: 也许。你如果想打，我就和你打。如果你想和平，那么以我一个可汗帮帮员的身份，我告诉你，我不会动手的。
source_text: 也许。你如果想打，我就和你打。如果你想和平，那么以我一个可汗帮帮员的身份，我告诉你，我不会动手的。

text: Let's fight.
source_text: Let's fight.

text: 打。
source_text: 打。

text: Let's not fight.
source_text: Let's not fight.

text: 不打。
source_text: 不打。

text: Word of a Khan? What a joke!
source_text: Word of a Khan? What a joke!

text: 可汗帮的誓言？笑话！！
source_text: 可汗帮的誓言？笑话！！

text: You are too strong for me, and I am tired by many days in the wastes. I do# not wish to die. Though it shames me, I surrender.
source_text:
You are too strong for me, and I am tired by many days in the wastes. I do
# not wish to die. Though it shames me, I surrender.

text: 你太壮了，我这几天都在废土里，累得要死。我不想死。这是很丢人，但是我还是要投降。
source_text: 你太壮了，我这几天都在废土里，累得要死。我不想死。这是很丢人，但是我还是要投降。

text: I agree. I give my word that you may go in peace, provided that you do not# provoke me. Do not trouble me again.
source_text:
I agree. I give my word that you may go in peace, provided that you do not
# provoke me. Do not trouble me again.

text: 同意，我们和平相处，只要你不要再来惹我。别来打扰我了。
source_text: 同意，我们和平相处，只要你不要再来惹我。别来打扰我了。

text: I don't want anything that belongs to a coward, including your life! Get# out of my sight!
source_text:
I don't want anything that belongs to a coward, including your life! Get
# out of my sight!

text: 我不想要懦夫的任何东西，包括懦夫的生命！滚开！
source_text: 我不想要懦夫的任何东西，包括懦夫的生命！滚开！

text: You stupid animal. I shall enjoy killing you.
source_text: You stupid animal. I shall enjoy killing you.

text: 你这个白痴的畜生，我就是要杀你为乐！
source_text: 你这个白痴的畜生，我就是要杀你为乐！

text: Uh, yes . . .
source_text: Uh, yes . . .

text: 呃，是的……
source_text: 呃，是的……

text: I shall enjoy hearing them. Farewell, brother!
source_text: I shall enjoy hearing them. Farewell, brother!

text: 我也喜欢听他们尖叫。再见了，老兄！
source_text: 我也喜欢听他们尖叫。再见了，老兄！

text: I shall enjoy hearing them. Farewell, sister!
source_text: I shall enjoy hearing them. Farewell, sister!

text: 我也喜欢听他们尖叫。再见了，老姐！
source_text: 我也喜欢听他们尖叫。再见了，老姐！

text: Really? Then I must have it for my own!
source_text: Really? Then I must have it for my own!

text: 是么？我自己去做！
source_text: 是么？我自己去做！

text: Yes, I have heard that fortune heavily favors you. It is for that reason# alone that I do not challenge you for your spoils. Farewell, my brother! May we# next meet side by side in battle.
source_text:
Yes, I have heard that fortune heavily favors you. It is for that reason
# alone that I do not challenge you for your spoils. Farewell, my brother! May we
# next meet side by side in battle.

text: 是的，我听说你是福星高照啊。就因为这个，我也不想惹你。再见了，老兄！也许下次我们能并肩作战。
source_text: 是的，我听说你是福星高照啊。就因为这个，我也不想惹你。再见了，老兄！也许下次我们能并肩作战。

text: Yes, I have heard that fortune heavily favors you. It is for that reason# alone that I do not challenge you for your spoils. Farewell, my sister! May we# next meet side by side in battle.
source_text:
Yes, I have heard that fortune heavily favors you. It is for that reason
# alone that I do not challenge you for your spoils. Farewell, my sister! May we
# next meet side by side in battle.

text: 是的，我听说你是福星高照啊。就因为这个，我也不想惹你。再见了，老姐！也许下次我们能并肩作战。
source_text: 是的，我听说你是福星高照啊。就因为这个，我也不想惹你。再见了，老姐！也许下次我们能并肩作战。

text: I am tired and weary from a journey many days longer than I expected. Rad# scorpions killed my companions. I long for the comforts of the camp and the# healing caress of our women.
source_text:
I am tired and weary from a journey many days longer than I expected. Rad
# scorpions killed my companions. I long for the comforts of the camp and the
# healing caress of our women.

text: 我走了太长的路，精疲力竭。辐射蝎杀了我的战友。我希望能露个营，让我的女人照顾我一下。
source_text: 我走了太长的路，精疲力竭。辐射蝎杀了我的战友。我希望能露个营，让我的女人照顾我一下。

text: May fortune again find favor with you. Farewell, my brother.
source_text: May fortune again find favor with you. Farewell, my brother.

text: 祝你好运再来，再见，老兄！
source_text: 祝你好运再来，再见，老兄！

text: May fortune again find favor with you. Farewell, my sister.
source_text: May fortune again find favor with you. Farewell, my sister.

text: 祝你好运再来，再见，老姐！
source_text: 祝你好运再来，再见，老姐！

text: They have destroyed Shady Sands. They kill anyone in their path. I never# dreamt such ferocity existed. We are all doomed . . .
source_text:
They have destroyed Shady Sands. They kill anyone in their path. I never
# dreamt such ferocity existed. We are all doomed . . .

text: 他们踏平了沙荫镇。他们一路不留活口。我没见过这么凶残的行径。我们都活不了了……
source_text: 他们踏平了沙荫镇。他们一路不留活口。我没见过这么凶残的行径。我们都活不了了……

text: Murdering dog!
source_text: Murdering dog!

text: 杀人狂！
source_text: 杀人狂！

text: No, but it is hard to tell. I have heard that they cloak themselves in# night, that they cloud men's minds, and take the form of beautiful women!# We are all doomed!
source_text:
No, but it is hard to tell. I have heard that they cloak themselves in
# night, that they cloud men's minds, and take the form of beautiful women!
# We are all doomed!

text: 不，很难的。我听说他们可以混在夜色之中无法追踪，他们可以摄人心魄，还可以化身变成美女，我们死定了！
source_text: 不，很难的。我听说他们可以混在夜色之中无法追踪，他们可以摄人心魄，还可以化身变成美女，我们死定了！

text: That is good. I long to avenge our dead, and even the dead of Shady Sands.# Any mutant that crosses my path will die! Go forth, friend! Go forth and kill!# Death to the mutants!
source_text:
That is good. I long to avenge our dead, and even the dead of Shady Sands.
# Any mutant that crosses my path will die! Go forth, friend! Go forth and kill!
# Death to the mutants!

text: 很好，我要为死去的战友、甚至是沙荫镇的百姓们报仇。那些变种人我要杀光他们！前进！朋友们！前进！杀杀杀！杀光变种人！
source_text: 很好，我要为死去的战友、甚至是沙荫镇的百姓们报仇。那些变种人我要杀光他们！前进！朋友们！前进！杀杀杀！杀光变种人！

text: You will die for those words!
source_text: You will die for those words!

text: 你说这种话，你就要死！
source_text: 你说这种话，你就要死！
